row.title: Check merged main for a same-directive PR before adding a parallel definition
row.body: SYSTEM-1 and COLDSTART-1 answered the same owner message in two threads; the later one was folded into the earlier on merge. collisions --claim <ID> catches same-id work only, so a directive answered under two ids slips through.

title: Check merged main for a same-directive PR before adding a parallel definition
